bugs.error_message: Code injection vulnerability: 6 handler functions embed JSON into Python code via template literals using .replace(/'/g, "\\'"), which fails if input contains triple single quotes '''
bugs.root_cause: JSON data was interpolated directly into Python f-strings via JS template literals. The single-quote escaping does not prevent triple-quote breakouts. Malicious input containing ''' could execute arbitrary Python code.
bugs.fix: Replaced all template literal injection with Pyodide VFS file writing: JSON is written to /tmp/*.json via pyodide.FS.writeFile(), then Python reads it with json.load(open(...)). Affected: handleCalibrate, handleAnalyze, handleRobustness, handleCounterfactuals, handleExport, handleValidate.

bugs.fix: Updated mountFromInline() to iterate over a _packages list and write an auto-generated __init__.py in each package directory, with experiment_engine as the root package included.

bugs.fix: Added exclude={'fuzzy_data'} to model_dump_json() call since fuzzy data is already saved separately as .npz file. The numpy array cannot be natively JSON-serialized.

bugs.fix: Changed to compute np.mean(t.solution_stability) for each test if the list is non-empty (else 0.0), giving the correct per-test aggregate before averaging across all tests.

bugs.error_message: 6 integration tests fail: test_validate prints wrong string, list-plugins command removed, run command expects new config format
bugs.root_cause: The CLI was refactored from pipeline-plugin system to text-calibration QCA system. Tests referenced removed commands (list-plugins) and expected old output formats ("Stages:" instead of "Condition names:", stages-based config instead of conditions-based).
bugs.fix: Replaced _make_valid_yaml_config() with _make_valid_condition_set()/_make_valid_corpus() helpers. Replaced list-plugins tests with list-conditions tests. Updated validate assertion to "Condition names:". Updated run assertions to "Done".

bugs.error_message: counterfactual.py produce_parsimonious_solution only includes easy counterfactuals, not all logical remainders
bugs.root_cause: The method filters logical remainders through _classify_counterfactual, only adding easy counterfactuals. Standard QCA (Ragin 2008) requires ALL logical remainders as don't-care rows for parsimonious solution.
bugs.fix: Add all rows with frequency < 1.0 as don't-care minterms (not just easy counterfactuals). Requires extending QM to support don't-care concept.

bugs.error_message: calibrate_ragin implements piecewise linear interpolation, not Ragin log-odds direct method
bugs.root_cause: The docstring claims Ragin log-odds method but the code at lines 389-421 is piecewise linear identical to calibrate_direct (only floor/ceiling changed to 0.05/0.95).
bugs.fix: Rewrite with logistic formula: log_odds = ln(m/(1-m)), deviation = (raw - crossover) * (log_odds_95 / (full_in - crossover)), membership = exp(deviation) / (1 + exp(deviation))
bugs.fixed_by: Rewrote calibrate_ragin() with logistic formula: log_odds_95 = ln(0.95/0.05), deviation = (raw - cross) * scale, membership = exp(dev) / (1+exp(dev)). Added np.clip(deviation, -700, 700) for overflow safety. All tests pass (360/360).

bugs.error_message: calibrator.py column index offset when mixing KEYWORD/HYBRID/PROTOTYPE scoring sources
bugs.root_cause: _compute_raw_scores() at line 165-167 uses col_idx (global position) to index match_corpus() result matrix (only KEYWORD/HYBRID columns). When PROTOTYPE conditions interleave with KEYWORD, the index is shifted.
bugs.fix: Build a col_idx -> kw_col_idx mapping before indexing.
bugs.fixed_by: Added _precompute_kw_context() that builds col_idx -> kw_col_idx mapping. _compute_raw_scores() now accepts optional kw_matrix and col_to_kw params and uses the mapping. process_with_outcome() and calibrate_one() also updated.

bugs.error_message: match_corpus() called once per KEYWORD condition causing O(n_conditions * n_texts * n_keywords) redundancy
bugs.root_cause: _compute_raw_scores at line 140,166 calls self._dict.match_corpus(texts) inside the per-condition loop. Each KEYWORD/HYBRID condition re-runs the full corpus match.
bugs.fix: Call match_corpus() once in process() and cache the result matrix. Reference cached columns by index.
bugs.fixed_by: Fixed alongside bug-36. _precompute_kw_context() caches match_corpus() result once. All callers (process, process_with_outcome, calibrate_one) use the cached matrix.

bugs.error_message: Pipeline passes corrupted data downstream after stage failure (silent data corruption)
bugs.root_cause: Pipeline.process() at line 277-286 catches stage exceptions but continues with "last good data". If TextCalibrationStage fails, QCAnalyzerStage receives raw text instead of fuzzy sets.
bugs.fix: Add fail_fast: bool config (default True for QCA pipelines). On stage failure, abort immediately with PipelineStatus.FAILED.
bugs.fixed_by: Added fail_fast: bool = True to Pipeline and ParallelPipeline. On failure with fail_fast=True: set PipelineStatus.FAILED, break loop. Added data_quality field to StageResult ('valid'/'stale'/None for failures). Added failed_stages property and fail_fast field to PipelineResult. Updated Pipeline.process() to re-raise on fail_fast=True. Updated 3 tests to match new behavior.

bugs.error_message: produce_parsimonious_solution produced identical output to intermediate solution — filtered logical remainders through _classify_counterfactual instead of treating ALL remainders as don't-care
bugs.root_cause: produce_parsimonious_solution applied _classify_counterfactual filter to logical remainders (matching intermediate solution behavior). Standard QCA (Ragin 2008) requires the parsimonious solution to treat ALL logical remainders as don't-care without easy/hard discrimination.
bugs.fix: Changed produce_parsimonious_solution to collect ALL frequency<1.0 rows as dont_care_minterms (no filtering). Extended QuineMcCluskey.minimize() with dont_care_minterms parameter — don't-care minterms participate in prime implicant generation but are excluded from the prime implicant chart covering requirement.

bugs.error_message: Quine-McCluskey did not support don't-care minterms, making parsimonious/intermediate solutions treat all remainders as outcome=1 minterms
bugs.root_cause: QM implementation only handled outcome=1 minterms with no concept of don't-care, preventing proper parsimonious solution generation.
bugs.fix: Added dont_care_minterms parameter to minimize(). All minterms (regular + don't-care) participate in grouping/combining. Chart columns only cover regular minterms (idx < n_reg). Don't-care minterms (idx >= n_reg) are excluded from the covering requirement. Removed dead code lines 43-44 (FIXME-18).

bugs.error_message: theoretical_expectation field always None for observed rows
bugs.root_cause: theo_exp initialized to None at line 57 and never assigned; _classify_counterfactual() used directional_expectations for easy/hard classification but never populated theo_exp
bugs.fix: Added loop in analyze() to build theo_exp string from directional_expectations: for each condition with an expectation, append '+name' or '-name'; join with ', '; set to None if no expectations exist

bugs.error_message: Condition name mismatch silently skipped in _compute_term_membership
bugs.root_cause: When a condition name (or negated condition name) didn't match any column in condition_matrix, the code silently passed (treated as 1.0 with no warning), hiding potential bugs
bugs.fix: Added warnings.warn() with stacklevel=2 in both the negated and non-negated branches when condition name not found; imported warnings module

bugs.error_message: coverage_stability always 0 in test_consistency_sensitivity because hasattr(tt, "solution_coverage") always False (TruthTable model has no such field)
bugs.root_cause: Code checked hasattr(tt, "solution_coverage") which is always False. TruthTable model has no solution_coverage field.
bugs.fix: Added _compute_solution_coverage() helper that computes real fuzzy-set solution coverage via term membership AND + union + ConsistencyCalculator. Used in both test_consistency_sensitivity and test_frequency_sensitivity.

bugs.error_message: test_calibration_sensitivity perturbs ALL membership columns including outcome, conflating calibration sensitivity with outcome sensitivity
bugs.root_cause: Method applied additive perturbation to membership.copy() (all columns including last/outcome), which conflates calibration sensitivity with outcome sensitivity.
bugs.fix: Renamed to test_membership_perturbation; now perturbs only condition columns (perturbed[:, :-1]) excluding outcome. Added backward-compatible test_calibration_sensitivity alias. Updated run_all to call the new name.

bugs.error_message: Docstring mentions bootstrap resampling but run_all() and RobustnessTester have no resampling-based methods
bugs.root_cause: Bootstrap resampling was documented but never implemented.
bugs.fix: Added test_bootstrap(n_iterations=100, sample_fraction=1.0) with case resampling with replacement, truth table + minimization per sample, Jaccard similarity tracking, and term appearance proportion reporting. Added to run_all().

bugs.error_message: Default frequency thresholds [1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0] may exclude all rows for small-N (<20) fuzzy-set QCA
bugs.root_cause: test_frequency_sensitivity always used absolute thresholds [1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0] regardless of n_cases, which can exclude all rows when n_cases < 20.
bugs.fix: Made thresholds adaptive: for N < 20 use proportion-based [0.05*N, 0.10*N, 0.15*N, 0.25*N]; for N >= 20 use absolute [1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0].

bugs.error_message: Quine-McCluskey has no upper bound on condition count k, causing browser WASM hang for k>12 due to O(2^k) explosion
bugs.root_cause: No guard existed on n_vars in minimize(). For k>12, the exponential enumeration of 2^k truth table rows blocks the single-threaded WASM environment indefinitely.
bugs.fix: Added k<=12 guard at top of minimize(): compute n_vars = len(minterms[0]), raise ValueError if n_vars > 12 with message guiding user to reduce conditions or use alternative algorithms.

bugs.error_message: LaTeX special characters (~ _ % $ # &) in user-provided text cause LaTeX compilation failures in generated reports
bugs.root_cause: No escaping was applied to any user-provided text before LaTeX insertion. ~ becomes non-breaking space, _ triggers subscript, %/$/#/&/{/} have special LaTeX meanings. Formula with ~ and * placed directly in math mode also causes errors.
bugs.fix: Added _escape_latex() static method (escapes % $ # & { } _ with backslashes, replaces ~ with \textasciitilde{}). Added _escape_latex_formula() static method (converts ~*+ to \neg \land \lor for math mode). Applied escaping to: outcome_name, config_label, condition_name, term labels, test names, parameter_varied, report summary, and solution formulas.

bugs.error_message: _robustness_section crashes with IndexError when t.solution_stability list is empty
bugs.root_cause: t.solution_stability[0] and t.solution_stability[-1] accessed without checking if the list is empty.
bugs.fix: Added guard: if t.solution_stability: ... else: stability_range = 'N/A'.

bugs.error_message: hash-based implicant identity in QM has theoretical collision risk and PYTHONHASHSEED cross-process instability
bugs.root_cause: hash((imp1, tuple(cov1))) used to track which implicants were combined. hash() has theoretical collision risk and depends on PYTHONHASHSEED which varies across process invocations.
bugs.fix: Replaced hash-based identity with itertools.count() sequential ID counter. Each implicant gets a unique integer ID at creation: (id, pattern, coverage). combined_this_round and used_in_combination track integer IDs instead of hash values. Updated all loops to 3-tuple unpacking.

bugs.error_message: pyodide.worker.ts handleCalibrate: _fuzzy_data variable never updated in accumulation loop — only last sample processed; _arr wraps FuzzySetData in object array, causing json.dumps failure

bugs.fix: Fixed in pyodide_handlers.py handle_calibrate: _fuzzy_data correctly reassigned in loop; membership extracted directly via _fuzzy_data.membership.tolist() instead of broken _arr.tolist() fallback.

bugs.error_message: pyodide.worker.ts handleExport imports non-existent class QCAReporter from qca_reporter; actual class is QCALaTeXReporter

bugs.error_message: No Content-Security-Policy header/meta tag — app deployed to GitHub Pages vulnerable to XSS, data exfiltration via injected scripts
bugs.root_cause: index.html had no CSP. GitHub Pages does not allow custom HTTP headers, so meta tag is the only enforcement mechanism.
bugs.fix: Added <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"> covering: script-src (self+jsDelivr), connect-src (self+jsDelivr+huggingface+cdn-lfs), worker-src (self+blob:), style-src (self+unsafe-inline for React), img-src (self+data:), font-src (self). Inline script hash not needed — Vite injects module scripts via <script type="module" src="...">. CSP verified present in dist/index.html after build.

bugs.error_message: Pyodide (~50MB jsDelivr) and BERT models (~100MB HuggingFace) loaded from CDN with no subresource integrity checks
bugs.root_cause: SRI computationally infeasible: (1) Pyodide loads 100+ .whl files programmatically via loadPyodide which bypasses <script integrity>; (2) BERT models dynamically resolved by Transformers.js at unknown URLs; (3) 100+ MB model files make SRI hash computation impractical.
bugs.fix: Added SECURITY NOTE comments to both files explaining SRI infeasibility and listing defense-in-depth measures. Added runtime Pyodide version check in handleInit() — compares loaded version against EXPECTED_PYODIDE_VERSION (0.26.4) and warns/errors if version is stale or below minimum.

bugs.root_cause: Used "<=" instead of ">="
bugs.fix: Changed operator <= → >=

bugs.error_message: GitHub Pages build failed: "Page build failed." with 0ms duration
bugs.root_cause: GitHub Pages legacy build system (build_type: 'legacy') rejects pushes from github-actions[bot] (GITHUB_TOKEN). The successful build was pushed by user qhWangAntoneva; all GITHUB_TOKEN pushes fail immediately (duration: 0). This is a known GitHub limitation — the legacy Jekyll-based build system does not properly process bot-triggered branch pushes.
bugs.fix: Switched from peaceiris/actions-gh-pages (branch-based legacy deployment) to the official GitHub Actions Pages deployment pipeline: actions/configure-pages@v4 + actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3 + actions/deploy-pages@v4. This replaces the peaceiris step with three official steps, changes permissions from 'contents: write' to 'contents: read, pages: write, id-token: write', and transitions Pages source from 'legacy' (branch-based) to 'workflow' (Actions-based). The gh-pages branch is no longer needed.

bugs.error_message: HTTP 422: Invalid Argument - failed to parse workflow: (Line: 42, Col: 3): Unexpected value administration. Push-triggered deploy workflow runs failed with 0 jobs.
bugs.root_cause: Line 42 had administration: write which is not a valid GitHub Actions permission scope. The YAML parser rejected the workflow at evaluation time, before any job could be created.
bugs.fix: Removed the invalid administration: write line from the permissions block. Valid permissions are contents: read, pages: write, id-token: write.

bugs.fix: Removed KeywordEntry from qca.py import block and __all__ list in __init__.py. Also removed all keyword residual code from condition.py: add_keyword() method, _kw_to_dict() function, _hybrid_*_weight fields, and keywords serialization in _condition_to_dict().

Every wolf hook that calls writeJSON() (post-write.js, post-read.js, session-start.js, stop.js, etc.) writes .wolf/token-ledger.json and similar files without trailing newlines, violating pre-commit's end-of-file-fixer.

bugs.error_message: end-of-file-fixer pre-commit hook persistently fails during git commit despite .wolf/hooks/pre-commit.js hook
bugs.root_cause: The .wolf/hooks/pre-commit.js PreToolUse hook only ran ruff format + ruff check --fix + git add -u before git commit. It did NOT cover non-ruff hooks (end-of-file-fixer, trailing-whitespace). When non-Python files (e.g., memory.md, token-ledger.json) lacked trailing newlines or had trailing whitespace, ruff (Python-only) ignored them. git add -u staged broken files. The real git pre-commit hook then modified them via end-of-file-fixer, creating unstaged modifications that conflicted with pre-commit stash/unstash mechanism, causing repeated commit failures.
bugs.fix: Replaced standalone ruff format + ruff check --fix commands with uv run pre-commit run --all-files, which runs ALL 8 configured pre-commit hooks (end-of-file-fixer, trailing-whitespace, check-yaml, check-toml, check-added-large-files, check-json, ruff, ruff-format). All fixes are applied before git add -u, ensuring the real pre-commit hook encounters clean files.

bugs.error_message: All 5 domains produce membership values of exactly 0.5 (zero variance/zero stddev) across all 30 cases, resulting in meaningless QCA results
bugs.root_cause: TextCalibrationStage.process() is called without text_embeddings and prototype_embeddings (CLI/api path has no BERT model). _precompute_scores() returns np.zeros() when embeddings are None. DirectCalibration maps all-identical zero scores to all-0.5 via min-max normalization degeneracy (score_min==score_max -> normalized=0.5, then 0.5 falls at crossover_point -> 0.5).
bugs.fix: Added _fallback_text_scores() static method using character trigram Jaccard similarity between input texts and prototype texts, with positive/negative prototype aggregation. _precompute_scores() now calls this fallback instead of returning zeros when embeddings are absent. Added _char_trigrams() and _jaccard() helper methods.

bugs.error_message: LaTeX reporter renders empty formula for vacuous QCA solutions (all outcome=1 or all outcome=0)
bugs.root_cause: _solutions_section() only checked `if sol and sol.terms` but did not check for empty formula. Vacuous solutions have sol.terms == [] and formula == ''. The code rendered `Formula: $\displaystyle $` - empty content.
bugs.fix: Added is_vacuous detection: empty/whitespace formula, or <=1 terms with zero consistency/coverage. Renders `\top` (always-true) with an explanatory note instead of empty formula.

bugs.error_message: DOCX reporter crashes with ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'SimHei'
bugs.root_cause: Line 42 `run.font.size = font_name` assigned a string ('SimHei') to an EMU integer field as a dummy before the real size was set on line 43. python-docx 1.2.0 validates the value immediately instead of allowing overwrite.
bugs.fix: Removed the dummy assignment that set font.size to a string. The real size is set on the next line correctly.

bugs.error_message: Unknown format code 'f' for object of type 'str' in validate_qca_output.py

bugs.fix: Added fmt_arr() helper that checks `np.issubdtype(arr.dtype, np.number)` before applying numeric formatting. String arrays are printed without min/max/mean/std.
